about_the_game:
This is a fun, casual third-person multiplayer combat game. Not only can you defeat your enemies with your weapons, but your bullets can also modify almost any object in the environment, including your enemies' attributes, helping you turn the tide of battle and increase your chances of winning! The game features a variety of maps, game modes, items, characters, and weapons, along with a full currency system for upgrading your characters and weapons.

In the game, you can:

  • Use a variety of weapons and characters with different abilities to defeat your opponents

  • Modify the position, size, rotation, voltage, and other attributes of almost any object in the map (including both enemies and yourself) to gain a tactical advantage

  • Move, create, and duplicate objects and buildings in the environment to build your own defensive fortifications

  • Earn gold through combat to upgrade your weapons and character abilities

  • Take advantage of the auto-aim feature to ensure a fair and enjoyable experience for all players

  • Work with your team to maximize your collaborative combat effectiveness

  • Create and share your own custom maps with other players
